name: Ammit Will

acquire.equipPiece: One crocodile-scale gauntlet on one hand; sand-gold streaks and a pale feather afterimage when the senses sharpen.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form Ammit-humanoid: long crocodile head and teeth, golden lion mane under a broad collar, broad clawed lion forearms holding a jaw-cleaver, heavy hippopotamus thigh plates, short digitigrade legs, a blunt scaled tail and a hovering feather-scale.

equip.weapon: A serrated crocodile-jaw cleaver (two gold fang blades) held in the clawed lion hand.
equip.armor: Sand-gold Egyptian plate: broad usekh-style collar over the lion mane, scale-plate hippo thighs, pharaoh-style bracers and a feather-scale pendant.
equip.hair_eyes: Thick golden lion mane; narrow amber crocodile eyes ringed with black kohl.
equip.aura: Sand-gold aura with black ash edges and a small hovering feather-scale.

beastNote: Ammit, Devourer of the Dead (crocodile head, lion forebody, hippopotamus hindquarters)
lore: A mana beast of the dust-lands that weighs the heart of every foe it meets and devours the ones found wanting; its will lets a tamer feel the weight of sin and tear it out.
pitch: Ammit is the Devourer of the Dead of Egyptian myth: crocodile head, lion forebody, hippopotamus hindquarters, who eats the hearts that are heavier than the feather. Acquire keeps you human with sand-gold streaks and one equipped piece, a single crocodile-scale gauntlet, to read the weight of a foe and harden your hide. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a croc-headed, lion-maned, hippo-thighed beastman in sand-gold plate with a jaw-blade, trading raw stats for a heart-eating self-heal at a heavy price.
untrained: An untrained holder is weighed too: the borrowed hunger gnaws the holder's own heart, strain climbs while the holder fights and the will refuses to heal until mastered. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A hunched croc-headed beastman in sand-gold Egyptian plate: long crocodile head with rows of teeth, golden lion mane under a broad collar, clawed lion forearms with a jaw-blade, heavy hippo thighs, short digitigrade legs, blunt scaled tail, a feather-scale over the chest.
spirit.look: A pale-sand orb with a black feather-shaped hollow in its centre and a small, slowly beating dark heart inside, sand drifting off its surface.
